{{Short description|House of Representatives of the Philippines legislative district}} {{Use mdy dates|date=February 2021}} {{Infobox constituency | name = Batangas's 4th congressional district | parl_name = [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] | image = {{maplink|frame=yes|type=shape|id=Q66771362|frame-align=center|stroke-color=#2C2C2C|zoom=9|frame-width=|stroke-width=2|plain=yesoverlay-horizontal-alignment=right|overlay-vertical-alignment=bottom|overlay=}} | caption = Boundary of Batangas's 4th congressional district | image2 = Ph locator batangas.svg | caption2 = Location of Batangas within the [[Philippines]] | district_label = Province | district = [[Batangas]] | region_label = Region | region = [[Calabarzon]] | population = 472,794 (2020){{PH census|2020}} | electorate = 307,973 (2022){{cite web|url=https://comelec.gov.ph/?r=2022NLE/Statistics/2022RVVAVmcocfinal|title=Number and Turn-Out of Registered Voters and Voters Who Actually Voted by City/Municipality May 9, 2022 National and Local Elections|website=Commission on Elections|accessdate=September 24, 2023}} | area = {{convert|757.69|sqkm|sqmi|abbr=on}} | towns = {{Collapsible list | titlestyle = font-weight:normal;text-align:left;background-color:WhiteSmoke; | title = 6 [[Local government in the Philippines|LGU]]s | '''Municipalities''' | [[Ibaan]] | [[Padre Garcia, Batangas|Padre Garcia]] | [[Rosario, Batangas|Rosario]] | [[San Jose, Batangas|San Jose]] | [[San Juan, Batangas|San Juan]] | [[Taysan]] }} | year = 1987 | members_label = Representative | members = [[Caloy Bolilia]] | blank1_name = Political party | blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Nacionalista Party}}|border=darkgray}} [[Nacionalista]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''Batangas's 4th congressional district''' is one of the six [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Batangas]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1987.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 4, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the eastern Batangas municipalities of [[Ibaan]], [[Padre Garcia, Batangas|Padre Garcia]], [[Rosario, Batangas|Rosario]], [[San Jose, Batangas|San Jose]], [[San Juan, Batangas|San Juan]], and [[Taysan]]. The city of [[Lipa, Batangas|Lipa]] was also part of this district until it was granted its own representation as the [[Batangas's 6th congressional district|sixth district]] effective 2016.{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=10673|title=An Act Reapportioning the Province of Batangas into six (6) Legislative Districts|date=August 19, 2015|access-date=June 13, 2016|url=http://www.senate.gov.ph/republic_acts/ra%2010673.pdf|publisher=Senate of the Philippines Legislative Digital Resources}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Caloy Bolilia]] of the [[Nacionalista Party]] (NP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 4, 2021}} == Representation history == {| class="wikitable" |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan="2" | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan="2" | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
